files.name: hero-v4-dodge-readable
files.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent RPG sprite atlas COLOR/MATERIAL EDIT. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET with exactly4 columns by4 rows on1024x1536 portrait canvas. Image2 is ONLY the approved palette/material reference; do NOT copy its standing poses or sword. Change ONLY clothing/skin material colors and lighting of image1 to match image2 exactly. Preserve all16 original bodies, same adult face/curly hair identity, naturally small head, head/body proportions, long slim limbs, exact pose, anatomy, hand/finger placement, eye direction, silhouette, sprite positions, grid, canvas dimensions and camera. Do not shorten legs, broaden torso, enlarge head, move/scale/repose any figure, or copy a sword from the palette reference. Keep hands EMPTY in every frame; retain existing small fixed belt sheath only if present. Match the readable idle palette: distinctly deep muted TEAL-GREEN cape with restrained gold stitching; fitted DARK COOL BROWN leather vest/belt/pouches with visible fine grain and seams, not honey orange; GREY-BROWN trousers, slightly lighter than the dark leather; IVORY white linen sleeves; neutral brushed STEEL shoulder; natural bright warm-neutral skin with human texture and separate dark hair. Preserve realistic leather/linen/wool/metal/skin surfaces, no cartoon, smooth plastic or uniform grey filter. The palette must be coherent with the reference so the action does not switch costume or body identity. Neutral soft daylight, no orange cast. Preserve true transparent alpha and fine edges; no opaque background, floor, shadow square, vignette, fog, glow over the full cell, grid borders, lettering, labels or extra objects. Preserve all source art geometry; material recolor only. Exact1024x1536 output.
Preserve the original compact4-phase sidestep dodge in each direction: ready, small lateral slip, trailing-foot catch, ready recovery. Keep row order front/down, right, back/up, left. No roll or crouching added.
